sources.title: Introducing Macaron-V1
sources.evidence: Dated July 21, 2026 and announces V1-Venti with open weights, a GLM-5.2 base, four specialists, and the 748B release label.

sources.title: Macaron-V1-Venti model card
sources.evidence: Names the model and Macaron-V1 family; describes BF16 weights, MIT licensing, chat/agent/coding/GenUI specialists, and 1M context. Distinguishes 748B release label from about 774.8B logical stored parameters; warns that the automatic sidebar count matches neither.

sources.title: Macaron-V1 technical report, revision 2 (August 24, 2026)
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 2.6 and Table 11 identify Venti separately: nominal 744B base, four adapters with 7,688,042,496 BF16 stored values each, approximately 774.8B logical residency, and 748B release label. Explicitly says stored values are not active-per-token counts. One specialist is selected per user turn.

sources.title: Venti checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM, glm_moe_dsa, 78 layers, 256 routed experts, eight experts per token, one shared expert, BF16, and max_position_embeddings=1048576. No vision or audio configuration.

sources.title: Venti native chat template
sources.evidence: Supports enable_thinking, reasoning effort, reasoning_content, think delimiters, function signatures, tool_call and tool_response tokens. Media inputs receive an explicit reminder that the model cannot process them because it lacks multimodal input ability.

sources.title: Venti license file
sources.evidence: MIT license with 2026 MindLab Research copyright. The model card also requires respecting inherited GLM-5.2 and harness-dependency requirements.

sources.title: Macaron-V1 developer repository and comparison table
sources.evidence: The Venti column identifies its GLM-5.2 base, 748B release label, approximately 774.8B logical residency, 1M context on B300 configurations, and 262K reference profile. The Tall and merged Coding-Venti builds are distinguished.

sources.title: Venti public repository metadata and file listing
sources.publisher: Hugging Face hosting Mind Lab weights
sources.evidence: Public repository includes 282 base shards and four L0-L3 adapter files at revision be05322da0f462b08e29166ab92eb98dd4c93d6c. Automatic safetensors total 753329940480 covers the base, including 19456 F32 router buffers, and omits the four adapter totals. Independent header reads establish the complete learned count.

sources.title: Mint Recursive hosted-model lineup
sources.evidence: Later documentation separately lists original macaron-v1-venti at 748B over frozen GLM-5.2, alongside newer Macaron-V1.1 over GLM-5.3. No active-parameter count for original Venti is provided.

sources.title: Pinned Venti base tensor index and complete shard headers
sources.evidence: Read only length prefixes and JSON headers of all 282 listed base shards via bounded HTTP ranges. All 59,585 index keys matched. Counts: 753329921024 BF16 weight/bias elements and 19456 F32 e_score_correction_bias buffer elements. Layer 78 contains 9952920320 BF16 MTP parameters and 256 of those buffers. No packed or quantized tensors.

sources.title: Pinned Venti L0-L3 adapter tensor headers
sources.evidence: Independently read all four adapter headers with bounded HTTP ranges. Each has 7688042496 BF16 elements, all in lora_A/lora_B parameter tensors; their sum is 30752169984. No buffer or scale tensors were found.

sources.title: GLM MoE DSA reference implementation: router buffers and MTP boundary
sources.evidence: Line 480 declares e_score_correction_bias as nn.Buffer rather than a learned parameter. Line 637 ignores layer 78 when loading the main decoder implementation, consistent with the separate MTP layer.

sources.title: Transformers GLM-5.2 implementation documentation
sources.evidence: Explicitly states that its GLM MoE DSA implementation omits the MTP layer. This confirms why a full released checkpoint count differs from a main-decoder-only scope.

sources.title: Developer GLM-5.2 training model configuration
sources.evidence: Exact GLM-5.2 configuration enables expert bias, sets moe-router-bias-update-rate=0, uses sigmoid top-8 routing, and unties embedding/output weights. The file comment explicitly names GLM-5.2 744B-A40B, corroborating the nominal 40B active base label.

sources.title: Developer checkpoint conversion: router-state mapping
sources.evidence: Maps Megatron mlp.router.expert_bias to HF mlp.gate.e_score_correction_bias. The adjacent dispatch module selects this converter for glm_moe_dsa.

sources.title: Megatron expert-bias state update implementation
sources.evidence: get_updated_expert_bias runs under torch.no_grad and adds update_rate times the sign of the token-load imbalance to expert_bias. This is load-control state updated outside gradient optimization, rather than an optimizer-learned affine bias.

sources.title: Z.ai GLM model download table: exact GLM-5.2 nominal size
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The official Download Model table labels both GLM-5.2 BF16 and GLM-5.2-FP8 as 744B-A40B. This establishes the named base model's nominal 40B activated count; Mind Lab separately identifies that base as frozen beneath Venti's specialist adapters. The label does not specify an MTP inclusion boundary or count Venti adapters.

sources.title: Official GLM-5.2 model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 to check exact base identity and architecture. Describes GLM-5.2 and IndexShare, but its current prose does not separately disclose a total or activated count; the explicit 744B-A40B specification is in the official repository download table.

name.note: Display normalization of the official Macaron-V1-Venti name.

developer.note: Existing normalized developer spelling; official sources use Mind Lab and MindLab Research.

family.note: Original Macaron-V1 family; distinct from V1.1 and the Preview release.

release_date.note: Explicit dated public release announcement; July 20 repository creation is not substituted for release.

open_weights.note: Developer announces open weights and the public exact-variant repository distributes base shards and four specialist adapters.

license.note: MIT is the published repository license. Inherited base-model and dependency requirements remain relevant.

parameters_b.note: Retains the previously audited complete learned-parameter total: 753329921024 BF16 base parameters, including 9952920320 MTP parameters, plus four 7688042496-parameter LoRA adapters, excluding 19456 non-gradient router-state values. The existing pinned header census and classification are preserved; no new shard reads or census were performed. Fresh October 27 reads of the release, card, report v2 and developer table retain 748B as a nominal release label and approximately 774.8B as residency computed from a nominal 744B base. Those published conventions do not supersede the complete checkpoint count. The disjoint component breakdown and router-state uncertainty remain in parameter_count_method.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 40B active for the frozen GLM-5.2 base component, inferred from Z.ai's exact GLM-5.2 744B-A40B release-table label and Mind Lab's explicit frozen-base relationship. Scope is base_model, excluding the four LoRA specialists; the sources do not establish a narrower MTP boundary. Full Venti active parameters remain undisclosed after fresh primary searches and rereading the card, report, repository and hosted lineup. The paper explicitly calls 7.688042496B per adapter a stored-tensor count, not an active-per-token count. No adapter budget is added and no route/answer/summary phase counts are invented.

architecture.note: GLM-5.2 sparse MoE Transformer backbone with MLA/DSA attention; 78 main layers (three dense, 75 sparse), 256 routed experts with top-8 routing and one shared expert, plus one MTP layer. Four routed LoRA specialists add the MoL serving layer.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint maximum. Developer documents 1M on B300 configurations and a lower 262K reference serving profile; training-system capacity beyond this is not the model context limit.

modalities.note: Native text model. Template explicitly rejects image, video and audio content; GenUI is generated code rendered by a harness, not native image output. Tall multimodal benchmark results do not apply.

reasoning.note: Native template includes thinking controls, reasoning effort and separate reasoning content.

tool_call.note: Native template serializes function definitions, tool calls and tool responses; the model is explicitly trained and served for agent use.

description.value: GLM-5.2-based Mixture-of-LoRA model with specialists for chat, personal agents, coding, and generative UI
description.note: All stated architecture and specialist domains are supported for this exact variant.

patch.notes: Complete checkpoint: 784.082091008B learned parameters, including MTP and four LoRA adapters; excludes 19,456 router-state values. Mind Lab retains a 748B nominal release label and ~774.8B residency using a nominal 744B base. Active 40B is a nominal inference for the frozen GLM-5.2 base only, from Z.ai's 744B-A40B label; excludes adapters. Full Venti active count remains undisclosed. Context maximum is 1,048,576 tokens; reference serving profile is 262K. MIT release retains inherited base-model and dependency requirements.

Pinned Venti base tensor index and complete shard headers
Pinned Venti L0-L3 adapter tensor headers
GLM MoE DSA reference implementation: router buffers and MTP boundary

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retains the prior complete learned total of 784.082091008B and distinguishes it from Mind Lab's nominal 748B label and ~774.8B nominal-base residency. Recovers a nominal 40B active count scoped to the frozen GLM-5.2 base through explicit first-party lineage; the complete Venti-plus-adapters active count remains undisclosed. No new tensor census; all twelve unrelated assessments are preserved.

parameter_count_method.method: For each indexed base shard and each of four adapter files, request bytes 0-7 to decode the safetensors header length, then request only that JSON header. Sum products of shapes once for each parameter tensor, and exclude e_score_correction_bias buffers identified in the reference implementation. No weight payloads downloaded.
parameter_count_method.scope_note: Includes auxiliary MTP parameters. The main model has untied embedding and output-head weights; the stored MTP head contributes its normalization only, with no duplicate embedding or output-head tensor. Adapter tensors are all BF16 lora_A/lora_B, not quantization storage or buffers.
parameter_count_method.buffer_classification: The 19456 F32 elements are exactly 76 x 256 e_score_correction_bias values. Transformers registers them as buffers; the developer converter maps them to expert_bias; Megatron updates that state from token-count imbalance under torch.no_grad; the developer GLM-5.2 training configuration sets its update rate to zero. They are excluded from optimizer-learned parameter tensors, not dismissed merely because they are F32.
parameter_count_method.classification_limit: No exact GLM-5.2 pretraining update-history record was verified. This exclusion follows the published parameter-versus-routing-state implementation. For an accounting convention that includes the saved routing state, the raw complete scalar total is 784082110464.

parameter_reaudit.method: Fresh primary total and active searches; reopened the original release, exact model card, technical report v2, developer repository, updated Mint lineup and GLM-5.2 training configuration; checked the official base model card and GLM download table. Preserved the previous accepted full-checkpoint census without downloading shards or making a new tensor census.
search_queries: Macaron V1 Venti active parameters GLM 5.2 40B
parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain exact complete total; establish nominal 40B activated frozen base component through explicit lineage. No first-party full Venti activated count was found. Secondary 41.8B estimates and ~40B family summaries were not adopted as complete-model disclosures; adapter stored totals were not relabeled as active.
